reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: My teenage son of Mira uses this and the results are simply excellent. His skin looks clean and almost all the wounds are gone. He combines it with the liquid soap and uses it on a daily basis.
reviews.zh: 我個teenage仔用Mira呢款，效果真係好好。佢塊面望落好乾淨，差唔多所有瘡都退晒。佢會同潔面液一齊用，日日都用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: ITS DIDNT REALLY WORK ON MY BLACKHEADS AND THE PRODUCT FOAMS UP IMMEDIATELY AFTER U PUT IT ON AND IF U GOT MILD BLACKHEADS ITS GOOD IF YOU GO EXTREME DONT BAD
reviews.zh: 用喺我嘅黑頭上真係冇咩效果，產品一搽上面即刻起泡。如果係輕微黑頭就用得，但嚴重嘅就唔好買。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: Es un producto suave con la piel. He buscado muchos limpiadores y ninguno me funciona ya que mi el se irrita pero este producto me ayudado mucho. Deja la piel suave.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品對皮膚好溫和。我試過好多潔面產品都冇用，因為我皮膚容易敏感發紅，但呢款產品幫咗我好多。用完皮膚好滑。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: I haven't tried it yet, I'm waiting for it to arrive and then I can expand on the smell, whether it's high quality, the size, the use, etc. I have other products from the company and their quality is excellent, the packaging is large and convenient, I hope everything will be the same
reviews.zh: 我未用過，依家等緊收貨，到時再同大家詳細講吓味道、品質、大細、用法等等。我有用開呢個品牌其他產品，質素都好好，包裝大又就手，希望今次都一樣。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: The green series is a series of AHA and BHA acids, suitable for oily skin, comedones, closed and open, use 4 times a week, only in the evening, second step in double cleansing
reviews.zh: Green 系列係一系列 AHA 同 BHA 酸性產品，適合油性肌、黑頭、閉口同開口粉刺，一星期用四次，只係晚上用，係雙重清潔嘅第二步。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text:
Great cleanser for clear skin!
I've been using the SOME BY MI Bye Bye Blackhead Cleanser for a few weeks now, and I love how it leaves my skin feeling fresh and smooth. The green tea and salicylic acid work well to unclog pores, and it bubbles up nicely, feeling gentle on the skin. However, I wouldn't recommend it for dry skin types. Overall, a solid choice for clearer pores! 
Definitely recommend.
reviews.zh:
想皮膚清爽一定要用呢款潔面！
我用咗 SOME BY MI Bye Bye Blackhead Cleanser 幾個星期，好鍾意用完皮膚清爽又滑嘅感覺。綠茶同水楊酸去毛孔效果好，泡泡豐富又細緻，皮膚感覺好溫和。不過乾性肌就唔建議用。整體係清潔毛孔嘅好選擇！
真心推介。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: I haven't seen any changes yet, I have sensitive skin so it's a little harsh on my skin but doesn't irritating. I really love the bubble effect and leaves my skin feeling clean.
reviews.zh: 我暫時未見到有咩變化，我係敏感肌，用落有少少刺激但又唔算敏感發作。我真係好鍾意嗰個泡泡效果，用完皮膚感覺好乾淨。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Bye Bye Black head 30 Days Miracle Green Tea Tox Bubble Cleanser 120g
reviews.text: Soy fan de Some by mi, es la primera marca que empecé a usar y sigue siendo una de mis favoritas, sobre todo la línea de 30 Days miracle y este limpiador es muy bueno te lo aplicas y crea una espuma la cual ayuda a limpiar y eliminar las impurezas, después de usarlo mi rostro queda súper limpio, normalmente lo uso de 2 a 3 veces por semana.
reviews.zh: 我係 Some by mi 嘅粉絲，係我第一個用嘅品牌，到而家都仲係我最鍾意嘅品牌之一，尤其係 30 Days miracle 嗰條線。呢款潔面都好好用，搽上面會起泡，有助清潔同去除污垢，用完塊面超乾淨，我通常一個星期用兩至三次。
